title: Combined Protein and Nucleic Acid Staining in Tissues with PANINI
author: Deisher, Yeo, et al.

steps.title: Prepare FFPE cell pellets
steps.instruction: Generate formalin‑fixed paraffin‑embedded (FFPE) cell pellets suitable for PANINI staining.

substeps.instruction: Culture at least 10 × 10⁶ 3D8 or CEMx174 suspension cells (or equivalent number for other lines) to obtain a visible pellet (Day 0.1).
Harvest cells 48 h after seeding and centrifuge in a 15 mL conical tube.
Fix the cell pellet in 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) prepared in 1× PBS, ensuring the pellet is completely submerged.
Place a HistoGel tube in a beaker of water and microwave in 10 s intervals until the gel is fully liquified.
Resuspend the fixed pellet with 250 µL liquified HistoGel by pipetting the gel into the bottom of the pellet and then covering the entire pellet.
Allow the HistoGel to coagulate around the pellet; trim away excess gel.
Transfer the gel‑embedded pellet into a 9‑compartment tissue cassette.
Submerge the cassette in 75 % ethanol and store at 4 °C for a minimum of 48 h.

steps.title: Secondary antibody staining (optional)
steps.instruction: Label bound primary antibodies with fluorescent secondary antibodies for conventional fluorescence microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Remove slides from the humidity chamber.
Wash slides 2 × 5 min in Staining Wash Buffer.
Prepare Secondary Antibody Cocktail: dilute each secondary antibody 1:200 in Antibody Diluent (see recipe table).
Add approximately 100 µL of the cocktail to each slide and incubate at room temperature for 1 h in the humidity chamber.
Wash slides again 2 × 5 min in Staining Wash Buffer using Coplin jars.
Place slides in a third Coplin jar containing 30 mL Staining Wash Buffer plus 5 µL Hoechst; incubate 5 min in the dark.
Rinse slides for 2 min in Staining Wash Buffer.
Pause point: slides may be kept in Staining Wash Buffer for up to 1 h at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C.
Mount a No. 1 coverslip (22 × 50 mm) over each slide using ~40 µL Antifade Mounting Medium containing DAPI; seal with clear nail polish.
Pause point: mounted slides can be stored in the dark at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks or at –20 °C for months.
Image the slides on a fluorescent microscope.
